reasoning: The National Archives publishes English HTML that expressly declares version 1.0. Its grant covers Information expressly made available under the licence, and its definition of Information includes data. This meets the Index criterion of an identifiable grant and edition supported by a controlling source. SCES-1.0 §§1–4 require authority for the actual proposition, exact source scope and a challenge to an identity merge. The government page establishes publication and edition.
